I can determine the SMILES notation only after I have some information about the sample. Could you please provide any of the following details?

- Molecular formula (or exact mass)  
- A brief description of the compound (functional groups, type of molecule, appearance)  
- ¹H NMR data (chemical shifts, multiplicities, integration)  
- ¹³C NMR data (chemical shifts)  
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)  
- Mass‑spectrometry data (m/z values, especially the molecular ion)

With at least one of these pieces of information I’ll be able to deduce the structure and give you the correct SMILES string.
